text.body: śrī dattātreya stutī dattātreyaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma nirañjanam | ādidevaṃ nirākāraṃ vyaktaṃ guṇavivarjitam || 1 || cinmayaṃ vyāpitaṃ sarvaṃ cidākāśaṃ digambaram | nirvikalpaṃ nirābhāsaṃ dṛśyadarśanavarjitam || 2 || agocaraṃ nirālambaṃ brahmacārī yatīśvaraḥ | bargalokanāyakaṃ smpūrṇaṃ paramātmanarakṣakaḥ || 3 || āśāpāśavibandhanamuktaḥ śaucāśaucavivarjitayuktaḥ | śūnyāgāre samarasamajñaḥ śuddhaviśuddhaṃ satatasamajñaḥ || 4 || dattātreya nāthottamaṃ sukhadaṃ paramānandasāgaram | citkīrtibhūṣaṇaṃ vande smartṛgāmī sa mā'vatu || 5 || harṣavardhanaṃ vande kauvalyasukhadāyakaṃ | sakalāgamapūjitaṃ vande smartṛgāmī sa mā'vatu || 6 || saṃsāratamanāśanaṃ saṃkalpaduḥkhadalanam | tāpatrayanivārakaṃ vande smartṛgāmī sa mā'vatu || 7 || saṃśayārṇavakhaṇḍanaṃ doṣatrayavibhedinam | brahmaprakāśātmānaṃ vande smartṛgāmī sa mā'vatu || 8 || bhārgavapriyakṛttamaṃ dūratvaparināśanam | jagadārjavapālanaṃ vande smartṛgāmī sa mā'vatu || 9 || namaste kālāgniśamanāya yogijanavallabhāya namo'stu te | namaste atriputrāya dattātreyāya namo'stu te || 10 || namaste līlāviśvambharāya avadhūtāya namo'stu te | namaste anasūyānandanāya digambarāya namo'stu te || 11 || namaste satvasādhyāya satvasākṣiṇe namo'stu te | namaste guhyatamāya cid vilāsāya namo'stu te || 12 || namaste kṣetrādhārāya kṣetraśūnyāya namo'stu te | namaste rupakāraṇāya gaganākṛtaye namo'stu te || 13 || śrī dattātreya pāhi māṃ prasīda digambara | kṣamasva avadhūta rakṣa rakṣa śrīguro || 14 ||
